name: Stretched (tenture: cloth on battens or boards)
process: The upholsterer's wall hanging (tenture murale): battens are fixed to the wall, a cotton wadding (molleton) is stapled over them, and the cloth is stretched over it from the centre of the wall outward, stapled closely along top and bottom and finished with a braid (galon); or held in clip profiles with an invisible edge. Panels and boards (case backs, screens) are covered the same way, the cloth wrapped round the edges; a blind is stretched on a frame.

steps.step: fix a frame of battens to the wall with mastic-adhesive
steps.source: Futura (la rédaction) (2020) 'Tenture murale et tissu tendu : deux types de pose', 16 November 2020, https://www.futura-sciences.com/maison/dossiers/decoration-revetement-mural-faire-bon-choix-971/page/6/

steps.step: staple the molleton (microperforated film on cotton wadding: acoustic and thermal comfort) every 10-15 cm
steps.source: Futura (la rédaction) (2020) 'Tenture murale et tissu tendu : deux types de pose', 16 November 2020, https://www.futura-sciences.com/maison/dossiers/decoration-revetement-mural-faire-bon-choix-971/page/6/

steps.step: cut the cloth with an 8-10 cm margin; position it loosely
steps.source: Futura (la rédaction) (2020) 'Tenture murale et tissu tendu : deux types de pose', 16 November 2020, https://www.futura-sciences.com/maison/dossiers/decoration-revetement-mural-faire-bon-choix-971/page/6/

steps.step: tension progressively from the centre of the wall outward, keeping the grain straight; staple every 2 cm, top and bottom, then the sides
steps.source: Futura (la rédaction) (2020) 'Tenture murale et tissu tendu : deux types de pose', 16 November 2020, https://www.futura-sciences.com/maison/dossiers/decoration-revetement-mural-faire-bon-choix-971/page/6/

steps.step: cover the edges with a galon or other trim; or use clip profiles for an invisible finish
steps.source: Futura (la rédaction) (2020) 'Tenture murale et tissu tendu : deux types de pose', 16 November 2020, https://www.futura-sciences.com/maison/dossiers/decoration-revetement-mural-faire-bon-choix-971/page/6/

salon.text: Each bay's silk wraps onto the faces of its piers corner to corner and stops 0.14 m short of each jamb; the jambs, arches and vault stay stone.
salon.source: plan/proposals/salon-interior/canvas/Plan.dc.html (approved Salon interior proposal); plan/proposals/salon-interior/canvas/Details.dc.html (approved Salon interior proposal)

salonSlots.text: A light slot under the cornice washes the silk down and one in the skirting washes it up.

reserve.text: Two fields of natural linen stretched on boards in each screen's fumed-oak frame.

surface.tension: Flat and taut with a very slight pillowing between battens; the weave straight; no seams on a pier face; seams on long walls at piece widths.

photograph: A continuous, softly padded plane of cloth; the braid or a crisp return at every edge.
A faint grid of battens under raking light.
sources: Futura (la rédaction) (2020) 'Tenture murale et tissu tendu : deux types de pose', 16 November 2020, https://www.futura-sciences.com/maison/dossiers/decoration-revetement-mural-faire-bon-choix-971/page/6/
